planos.01-balcao: The woman hands the paper bag and the coins to the boy, he takes them and gives a small polite bow, both smiling. Static camera.
planos.02-mei-tchau: The woman waves goodbye and talks warmly with a big smile, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.03-nota: The boy looks at the banknote in his hand, his eyes widen in surprise. Slow push-in.
planos.04-vitrine: The boy leans toward the shop window, staring at the sticker album, then looks at the banknote. Static camera.
planos.05-duvida: The boy scratches his head, looks to the side doubtfully and whispers, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.06-cozinha: The father kneads the dough and looks up smiling, the boy walks in slowly, head down. Static camera.
planos.07-pai-pergunta: The father tilts his head kindly and asks a question, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.08-kenji-conta: The boy lifts his eyes and confesses softly, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.09-pai-ombro: The father gently places his hand on the boy's shoulder and speaks with a warm smile, the boy nods. Static camera.
planos.10-corre: The boy runs fast along the sidewalk with determination, tracking shot.
planos.11-devolve: The boy holds out the banknote and talks, the woman raises her eyebrows in surprise. Static camera.
planos.12-mei-comovida: The woman puts her hand on her heart and speaks warmly, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.13-carroca: Mist drifts slowly over the mountains, the ox flicks its tail, the cart stays still. Slow camera pan.
planos.14-cha: The woman pours tea, steam rises, the boy smiles and holds the cup with both hands. Static camera.
planos.15-pipa: The woman lifts the red dragon kite and speaks excitedly, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.16-kenji-uau: The boy gasps with amazement and smiles wide, eyes sparkling. Slow push-in.
planos.17-riem: The boy and the woman laugh together holding the kite. Static camera.
planos.18-lanternas: The red lanterns sway gently in the evening breeze, warm light flickering. Static camera.
planos.19-resumo: The three smile at the camera, the father puts his arm around the boy, the woman waves. Static camera, subtle motion.
